description: This file defines a React component for a video call interface, including UI elements for joining a call, displaying meeting info, and handling user authentication overlays. It integrates with Daily.co for video conferencing and includes custom UI components and hooks.

methods.name: createCallFrame
methods.description: Creates and configures a Daily.co call frame with custom theme and tray buttons based on props.

methods.name: ProgressBar
methods.description: Displays a progress bar indicating remaining time for a scheduled meeting.

methods.name: LogInOverlay
methods.description: Component for user to enter name and email to join a call, handling guest session creation.

methods.name: VideoMeetingInfo
methods.description: Displays detailed information about the scheduled video meeting, including time, attendees, and description.
